title: Reed Turchi lets the slide guitar roar on “Get Back Train - Wild Coyote Sessions”
htmlContent: Reed Turchi is back, and this time the slide guitar takes center stage. With the release of his latest single, "Get Back Train - Wild Coyote Sessions," Turchi continues to prove why he's one of the most compelling voices in modern swampy roots and blues. The track is an electric slide-guitar-driven piece, is the first glimpse of his upcoming EP, 'Wild Coyote Sessions.' If Turchi's spring album, World on Fire, was a testament to strength and heartfelt storytelling, then "Get Back Train" marks a return to raw, unfiltered groove, the kind that rattles your bones and pulls you straight into the humid, electric air of the blues tradition. Turchi's guitar twists like a wild animal, evoking both the urgency of a freight train barreling down the tracks and the timeless soul of the Delta. There's a grit in his tone that feels earned, a lived-in quality that captures both the tradition of the blues and the restless energy of an artist who refuses to sit still. The single also sets the stage perfectly for "Wild Coyote Sessions," a project that promises to channel the untamed spirit its name suggests. While World on Fire found Turchi navigating personal spaces and gathering deep support from fans, this new chapter dives into something wilder, darker, and more visceral. https://open.spotify.com/track/39ADh6vbMvppwh5vuOXqL2 "Get Back Train" is a statement that Reed Turchi is embracing the raw edge of his craft, and he's inviting listeners along for the ride. With "Get Back Train - Wild Coyote Sessions," Reed Turchi once again reminds us why he's a standout in the modern blues scene. This is a stomp, a cry, a piece of music that feels alive in the moment. And if this single is any indication, the full EP will be a fierce, electrifying journey well worth waiting for.
